title: Understanding the Models
text: The first image shows two different models for linear regression. The first model uses the original design matrix, while the second uses the mean-centered design matrix. Consider how centering affects the regression coefficients.

title: Analyzing the Scatter Plot
text: The scatter plot shows a clear negative linear trend. This indicates that as the feature value increases, the response value decreases. Consider how this trend affects the choice of parameter for minimizing test MSE.

title: Effect of Centering on Coefficients
text: Centering the data can affect the intercept but not the slope of the regression line. Since the scatter plot shows a linear trend, focus on how centering impacts the slope and test MSE.

title: Choosing the Parameter
text: Given the negative linear trend in the scatter plot, which parameter (theta_A or theta_B) is likely to achieve a lower test MSE?
